import numpy as np, os, sys
from PIL import Image,ImageDraw
P='/work/study/'
w,h=320,180
N=os.path.getsize(P+'low.rgb')//(w*h*3)
A=np.memmap(P+'low.rgb',dtype='uint8',mode='r',shape=(N,h,w,3))
if sys.argv[1]=='match':
 for id in range(1,5):
  for j in [1,2]:
   im=Image.open(f'/input/input/resume_cards/RC{id:02}_{j:02}.png').convert('RGB'); im={2:lambda:im.transpose(Image.Transpose.FLIP_LEFT_RIGHT),3:lambda:im.transpose(Image.Transpose.ROTATE_180)}.get(id,lambda:im)(); assert im.size==(1380,1080)
   B=np.array(im.resize((230,180),Image.Resampling.BILINEAR))[::3,::3].astype('int16'); dif=np.array([np.abs(a[:,:230][::3,::3].astype('int16')-B).mean() for a in A]); print(id,j,[(v/2,round(dif[v],2)) for v in np.argsort(dif)[:4]])
elif sys.argv[1]=='detect':
 # diagram strokes have low saturation and characteristic dark edges. look for persistent changes in spatial stroke mask
 X=A[:,2:110,210:319]; Y=(X.max(-1)-X.min(-1)<13)&(X.max(-1)<178); D=(Y[1:]!=Y[:-1]).sum((1,2)); np.save(P+'d.npy',D)
 print([(i/2+0.5,int(v)) for i,v in enumerate(D) if v>120])
else:
 ts=list(map(float,sys.argv[2].split(','))) if ',' in sys.argv[2] else np.arange(*map(float,sys.argv[2:5])); typ=sys.argv[1]; cols=5 if typ=='d' else 4; ww,hh=(180,165) if typ=='d' else (320,198); O=Image.new('RGB',(cols*ww,((len(ts)+cols-1)//cols)*hh),'white'); d=ImageDraw.Draw(O)
 for i,t in enumerate(ts):
  if int(t*2)>=N: break
  img=Image.fromarray(A[int(t*2)]); x=i%cols*ww;y=i//cols*hh
  if typ=='d': img=img.crop((204,0,320,96)).resize((180,149))
  O.paste(img,(x,y));d.text((x+3,y+hh-17),f'{t:g}  {int(t)//60:02}:{int(t)%60:02}',fill='black')
 O.save(P+'sheet.jpg',quality=93)

import os,sys,subprocess, concurrent.futures
from PIL import Image,ImageDraw
ROOT='/work/study'; SRC='/input/input/tutorial.mp4'
os.makedirs(ROOT+'/hi',exist_ok=True)
def path(t): return ROOT+f'/hi/{float(t):07.2f}.jpg'
def fetch(t):
 p=path(t)
 if not os.path.exists(p): subprocess.run(['ffmpeg','-nostdin','-v','error','-ss',str(t),'-threads','2','-i',SRC,'-frames:v','1','-threads','1','-q:v','2','-y',p],check=True)
 return p
def paths(ts):
 with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=7) as e: return list(e.map(fetch,ts))
if __name__=='__main__':
 typ,out,*ts=sys.argv[1:]; ts=list(map(float,ts)); pp=paths(ts)
 if typ=='cache': quit()
 box,ww,hh,n = {'diagram':((1280,0,1920,485),310,241,5),'hand':((0,0,1390,1080),289,242,5),'full':((0,0,1920,1080),420,254,4),'pair':((0,0,1920,1080),540,322,3)}[typ]
 o=Image.new('RGB',(ww*n,hh*((len(ts)+n-1)//n)),'white');d=ImageDraw.Draw(o)
 for i,(p,t) in enumerate(zip(pp,ts)):
  im=Image.open(p).crop(box);im.thumbnail((ww,hh-18),Image.LANCZOS); x=ww*(i%n);y=hh*(i//n);o.paste(im,(x,y));d.text((x+5,y+hh-17),f'{t:g} | {int(t)//60:02}:{int(t)%60:02}',fill='black')
 o.save(ROOT+'/'+out+'.jpg',quality=94)
